"""Main owns focused and complete fake-engine regression for this server port."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-upstream-v0143-replica-server-20261012')
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('current_update_cpu_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['focused', 'full', 'setup'], required=True)
parser.add_argument('--attempt', choices=range(1, 7), type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--lint-proof', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',
           TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1')

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / ('main-current-update-replica-' + args.phase + '-root-v' + str(args.attempt))
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))}, phase=args.phase, evidence={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, wall=300):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 8 + 60,
                             rss_cap=16 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text(), se.read_text()

    try:
        assert args.lint_proof.is_relative_to(B)
        lint = json.loads(args.lint_proof.read_text())
        assert lint['passed'] and lint['complete'] and not lint['active'] and not lint['comparison']['added']
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in lint['changed_source_pins'].items())
        r['lint_receipt'] = dict(path=str(args.lint_proof), sha256=m.sha(args.lint_proof))
        _, se = run('reviewed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        tracked = run('server-files', ['git', 'ls-files', 'serve'])[0].splitlines()
        extra = run('new-server-files', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', 'serve'])[0].splitlines()
        r['source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in sorted(set(tracked + extra)) if (W / p).is_file()}
        r['source_pins'].update(lint['changed_source_pins'])
        r['changed_source_pins'] = lint['changed_source_pins']
        argv = [str(L / 'venv/bin/python3'), '-B', '-m', 'unittest']
        if args.phase == 'focused':
            argv += ['serve.test_upstream_stream_recovery', 'serve.test_replicas', 'serve.test_cpu_affinity', 'serve.test_replica_admission', 'tools.test_setup_replicas', 'serve.test_restart_waiters', '-v']
        elif args.phase == 'setup':
            argv += ['tools.test_setup_replicas', 'tools.test_setup_pins', 'tools.test_setup_rope', 'tools.test_setup_parallel', 'tools.test_setup_llama_archive', 'tools.test_setup_http_bench_offer', '-v']
        else:
            argv += ['discover', '-s', 'serve', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v']
        _, se = run('server-regression', argv, wall=900 if args.phase == 'full' else 120)
        hit = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s', se)
        assert hit and re.search(r'^OK(?:\s|$)', se, re.M)
        assert int(hit[1]) >= (15 if args.phase == 'focused' else 1 if args.phase == 'setup' else 581)
        skip = re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)', se, re.M)
        r['unittests'] = dict(tests=int(hit[1]), elapsed_seconds=float(hit[2]), skipped=int(skip[1]) if skip else 0,
                              individual_results=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('test_')])
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['source_pins'].items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
